evals.name: prioritize-all-open-issues
evals.prompt: Analyze and prioritize all open issues in the sonnet GitHub repo. Use the skill to fetch issues, understand our current engine status from AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, and produce a prioritized report. Separate issues into: Quick Wins (high UX impact, low code change), Medium Fit (align with current/next milestone), and Deferred (blocked by future work or architectural constraints). Don't post comments yet—just show me the report so I can review it.
evals.expected_output: A markdown report with issues grouped into three priority tiers, each with impact/effort/blocker analysis and reasoning

evals.name: quick-win-identification
evals.prompt: Focus on finding quick wins in the open issues. What are the highest-impact, lowest-effort issues we can tackle to improve user experience without major engine changes? List them with specific reasoning about why they're quick wins.
evals.expected_output: A filtered list of issues in Priority 1 (Quick Wins) with clear impact and effort justification

evals.name: roadmap-mismatch-detection
evals.prompt: Identify which open issues don't fit our current roadmap. For each misaligned issue, explain why (blocked by future milestone, architectural mismatch, out-of-scope) and draft a GitHub comment that would help the issue author understand where this fits in our plans.
evals.expected_output: Issues in Priority 3 with reasons and suggested comment text for each one
